A heat warning means hot weather is expected for two or more days; roughly highs of 31 C or more with lows of 20 C or more, or a humidex of 40 or more. An extended heat warning means that kind of heat is expected to last longer, about three days or more, usually with extra supports like cooling centres. Check Environment Canada for your area's exact criteria. Action: none.

ACH is the American system (Automated Clearing House), while in Canada the equivalent is EFT, electronic funds transfer, which runs through Payments Canada's batch systems. So on a Canadian call they usually mean the same kind of bank-to-bank batch payment, though ACH is technically the US term. Action: none.

RRSP: contributions are tax-deductible now and taxed when you withdraw, best when your tax rate today is higher than it will be in retirement. TFSA: contributions are after-tax, but growth and withdrawals are tax-free and flexible, best when your rate is lower now or you may need the money sooner. Action: none.

Pastel de nata come from Belem in Lisbon, where monks at the Jeronimos Monastery started making them in the early 1800s. The Kid version: the monks had lots of leftover egg yolks, so they turned them into little custard tarts. A bakery near the monastery began selling them in 1837 and still does. Action: none.
